additional_info.subject: ID0438556-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / PN 170001049] Error message CRM:02919000209
additional_info.body:
Hello Stefan, good morning.
I checked the logs from the day you provided and it seems there was a requested reboot in the middle of a charging session:
I can see that there was a error with the charging point 2.
I installed a hotfix for this error which is related to a communication error and the issue is resolved for now.
If you face any issues afterwards please raise another ticket. I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you and have a nice start of the week.
Best regards,
Francisco
